name: Numakers ABS @Solder
filament_notes: Numakers ABS Natural 1 kg, Spoolman spool 3. WARNING: this is an OPEN-FRAME Ender 3 with no enclosure. ABS warps, splits layers on tall parts and emits styrene fumes - ventilate. Bed 100, the floor for ABS: the thermistor reads the aluminium under 4 mm of glass, so the glass face runs about 10 below the target. Bare carborundum glass does not hold ABS: use glue stick or ABS slurry, or the PEI sheet. Part cooling fully off, overhangs included. Pair with 0.20mm ABS @Solder, which carries the brim and the draft shield.
filament_start_gcode:
SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0.0 ; TODO tune per material, see machine/calibration.md
SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z=-0.2 MOVE=1 ; ABS first layer squish, START_PRINT resets it to 0
